title: a7R III dual-conversion-gain cross-ratio, ISO 640 vs ISO 100
method: 3 interleaved frame pairs, broadband W LED, 1/2000 s f/8 fixed; central-50% ROI, 1-99 percentile trimmed means per CFA channel (the anchor engine's numeric core, then roll_anchor_extractor.py, merged into roll_anchor_gui.py 2026-07-22); ratio = ISO640/ISO100 per pair, averaged
usage: divide an ISO 640 frame's shutter-normalized linear rate by gain_ratio[ch] to express it on the ISO 100 scale (Dmax vs ISO 100 plain-light reference)
caveat: re-measure if camera body or firmware changes; shutter was 1/2000 s — PWM beat risk was checked via the per-pair spread below
location_note: rig constant, lives in data/equipment/ (moved 2026-07-17 from gain_ratio_analysis/, where the source ARWs remain as provenance)
